scope: Native IPv4/IPv6 actual-peer CIDR, lazy system OpenSSL TLS1.2/1.3, bounded credential helper and private reload, local mTLS/CRL, CORS/OPTIONS. TLS-OFF and plaintext do not load crypto. Explicit old nginx remains optional. Unchanged engine binary and numerical contract; changed shared HTTP receiver used by this new ingress only.
review: Certificate files read only in exec helper with 2s deadline and 100ms cleanup; unreaped helper retains service-level kernel lease. Failed reload keeps unexpired context; expiry closes new TLS handshakes/admission without model restart. Old contexts finish existing SSE. v4 seals external credential paths; old package inventories preserved. OpenSSL uses explicit fixed library path, no implicit config loading. Early TLS auth rejection drains at most 64KiB/100ms after close_notify, preserving late-body response.
limitations: Targeted CPU passed; final Release/native model short acceptance pending. No remote OCSP/CRL fetching, active-session retroactive revocation, full model/performance or long stability claim. Standard API completion remains required in A tasks; HTTP persistent/chunked/upload integration remains N05, not removed.
